title: A little different. A lot to feel.

questions.title: Which version sounds loudest?
questions.description: Think about how loud it feels, rather than the volume setting.

questions.title: Which version sounds clearest?
questions.description: Listen for how distinctly you can hear the sounds in the music.

questions.title: Which version sounds harshest?
questions.description: Think about an abrasive or piercing quality in the sound.

questions.title: Which expresses the most emotion?
questions.description: Judge how strongly the music expresses emotion, rather than how you personally feel.

questions.title: What shaped that feeling?
questions.description: If a version felt more emotional, which qualities contributed? Choose any, or skip.

questions.title: What's usually in your headphones?
questions.description: Tell us the genres you enjoy, or anything else you noticed. Please leave out names and contact details.
